title: Benchmark Dataset Manifest v0.2
description: Turn P6.1: adds explicit dataset PROVENANCE (dataset_role/holdout_accessed/official_gold_accessed/grading_detail_visibility) to fix a real contradiction in v0.1 (dataset-manifest.schema.json, PRESERVED UNCHANGED, never modified by this Turn): v0.1's own holdout_gate.unlocked could legitimately be true (a real HOLDOUT unlock succeeded), while the OLDER benchmark-comparison-report.schema.json (v0.1, also preserved unchanged) locked holdout_accessed to `const: false` regardless -- a provable contradiction whenever a real HOLDOUT unlock actually happened. v0.2 does not relax v0.1's own meaning; it is a NEW, additive, explicitly-versioned contract domain/agent-comparison/benchmark/dataset.mjs now produces and validates against instead. dataset_sha256's own MEANING also changed for v0.2's caller (domain/agent-comparison/benchmark/item-sha.mjs's computeDatasetItemsSha256 now canonically hashes every expected_* field, not just evaluation_item_id/question/split) -- the pattern/shape of the field itself is unchanged (still a bare sha256 hex string), only what it is computed over.

dataset_sha256.description: sha256 over the canonicalized, evaluation_item_id-sorted projection of EVERY expected_* field (plus question/hints/split/evaluation_group_id/chain_component_id/grading_policy_version) for every item actually loaded -- see domain/agent-comparison/benchmark/item-sha.mjs's computeDatasetItemsSha256. Changing any one item's expected content changes this hash; reordering the same items does not. Only the digest is ever stored here -- raw Gold content is never copied into this manifest.

dataset_role.description: Caller-declared classification of what this dataset FILE is -- SYNTHETIC/SEED_SMOKE fixtures never carry official Gold content; DEV_GOLD/HOLDOUT_GOLD do. This is the ONE input a caller supplies about provenance; holdout_accessed/official_gold_accessed/grading_detail_visibility below are then ALL mechanically derived from it plus the real holdout_gate -- a caller cannot pass those three directly (domain/agent-comparison/benchmark/dataset.mjs's loadDatasetRecords does not even accept them as parameters).

holdout_accessed.description: true ONLY when holdout_gate.unlocked is true AND holdout_gate.holdout_item_count > 0 (a REAL, canUseSplit-verified HOLDOUT unlock actually admitted at least one HOLDOUT row this load) -- mechanically derived, never a caller-supplied boolean.

official_gold_accessed.description: true iff dataset_role is DEV_GOLD or HOLDOUT_GOLD -- mechanically derived from dataset_role, never a caller-supplied boolean.

grading_detail_visibility.description: REDACTED iff dataset_role is HOLDOUT_GOLD, else FULL -- mechanically derived. domain/agent-comparison/benchmark/runner.mjs reads this to decide whether a BenchmarkItemResult's scoring.axes[*].details may carry expected_value/expected_date/expected fact-event-relation ids (FULL) or must be stripped to matched_count/expected_count/a redacted marker only (REDACTED) -- see runner.mjs's own redactAxisDetailsForHoldout.
